posts.cooked:
So I'm assuming Handelabra did their homework so this is more just confirmation:

The Title Chaos Lord states when a Player plays more than 3 cards in one turn, place this title under that player's Hero Character Card...

I guess there is some fine print here that states that the Villain counts as a Player, Title cards are played by the Villain and the title goes to either the Villain Character target card or the Villain card with the highest HP?

I had Chaos Lord go to Impassable Andolin (Kaargra was not flipped) on Kaargra's turn who played two cards plus a Title card after a target was destroyed.

posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
If so, I think that's an error.  Kaargra doesn't have a "Hero Character Card" and she shouldn't count as a Player if you ask me.

 

Are you sure she didn't play Bloodswarn Judgement?  It automatically puts the Title on top of the deck under the Villan target with the highest HP.  That card sounds much more logical as the method by which a Villain target could get Chaos Lord.
